text: Okay... hm, I really don't want to do any of those. Honestly, I'd rather not do that if there's another way. I think I'm just going to have to call customer service again later and try to figure out the right order number for the earbuds. Thanks for trying to help though.
zh: 好的...嗯，我真的不想做任何这些。老实说，如果还有其他办法，我宁愿不做。我想我只好稍后再次呼叫客服，并尝试弄清楚包含耳机的正确订单号。虽然如此，感谢您尝试帮助。
